entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Greatest Christmas ever!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And Morgana's back, too.[n]I'm so glad!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Gosh, I think I'm tearing up[n]again...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Lady Ann...! I'm glad to be back too!
Morgana's happy as well.
Sounds like he's glad too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Here's a pic for you, Mona! A nice[n]little post-party snapshot!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Aha... A splendid picture.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes. Somehow, seeing them[n]together puts me at ease.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You and him are pretty close[n]by now, huh, [fName]?
A close friend.
He's family.
He's a pet.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Hmph! You say that like you're all[n]grown up now!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Still, I'm glad to hear it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Family, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So I'm basically your older brother,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't treat me like a housecat!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Anyway, don't go disappearing[n]again, got it? I don't wanna worry[n]about you like that anymore.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Futaba...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right. Tonight's supposed to be[n]a celebration... I'm glad I could be a[n]part of it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I know I already said it, but... Thanks,[n]everyone. I'm glad I got to come back[n]to you.
